loss_reason: Closed-lost: customer selected competitor (BigCloudAI) because they provided managed PrivateLink + faster onboarding; internal budget freeze and champion attrition accelerated decision
notes: Summary: Large EU logistics platform evaluating Redwood for agent + doc search + rerank. Strong security/residency requirements (EU keys, KMS/HSM, SSO).
Timeline (high level):
- 2025-07-22: initial inbound, matched on performance benchmarks; assigned AE Lena. Lead = Head of Platform (Luis Gonçalves).
- 2025-08-15: discovery call — emphasized private networking (PrivateLink preferred) and EU data residency. Asked about HSM/KMS path for Private deployment.
- 2025-09-10: demo of hosted + dedicated flow; SE Arjun ran architecture review (notes in drive). Customer asked for VPC peering + PrivateLink support and per-route audit logging.
- 2025-10-06: POC kickoff — sandbox Dedicated cluster. Fireflies: ff_2025-10-06_poc-kickoff.

- 2025-11 to 2026-01: security review loop. Redwood Private roadmap indicated PrivateLink support 'planned Q1 2026' but not GA. Security team pushed back — wanted vendor-managed PrivateLink or a turnkey option.
- 2026-01-28: architecture deep-dive with security & infra. Fireflies: ff_2026-01-28_pelagos_sec_call. They reiterated no-exception policy for cross-account endpoints without PrivateLink.
- 2026-02-15: internal change — Pelagos' Head of Cloud (internal champion) left to competitor. Sponsor engagement dropped.
- 2026-02-21: budget freeze announced by CFO pending consolidation of vendor contracts. Finance unwilling to sign conditional roadmap commitments.
- 2026-02-25: Pelagos chose BigCloudAI: competitor offered managed PrivateLink endpoint + shorter legal/integration path. Outcome marked closed-lost.
Deal nuances / customer signals:
- Very cost-aware on per-token economics for reranking pipelines (high QPS) but security/residency trumped unit-cost tradeoffs.
- Wanted single-vendor managed networking to avoid engineering lift (their infra team is lean). Quote from security: 'We cannot accept vendor roadmap promises for core networking.'

- Multiple asks left open: HSM-backed key management in EU, per-route audit logs, and turnkey PrivateLink endpoint. Redwood's partial support for VPC + on-prem didn't meet the "managed PrivateLink" bar.
POC artifacts: sandbox cluster logs, performance report (drive link), SE notes (INF-2437).
Next actions taken by Redwood sales:
- Closed deal as lost, sent internal win/loss to GTM and product with detailed ask list (see SEC-5210).
- Proposed re-engagement cadence: check roadmap updates quarterly and offer migration assistance if Pelagos re-evaluates in 6-9 months.
Open opportunities / potential re-entry triggers:
- If Redwood ships managed PrivateLink + turnkey onboarding and completes EU HSM/KMS integration, re-open opportunity.
- If Pelagos' budget unfroze or new champion emerges in infra/platform, they may reconsider (low probability in next 6 months).
Internal notes for AE/SE:
- Document the exact security checklist that lost the deal (PrivateLink + managed endpoints, contract SLAs for networking).
- Flag product team: customer requested 'managed PrivateLink with audit logging and EU KMS' — prioritize in roadmap discussions.
Contact cadence: set to 'pause' — only product roadmap updates. Re-engage when PrivateLink GA + legal template available.
